scorecard_items.behavior: No-LLM distill clusters generated signatures by canonical class/key, records signature-only provenance, and caps confidence at 0.6 until three confirmed experiences.
Stable signature IDs still keep failure and revert evidence in one deterministic cluster.
Drafted rules remain suggested or needs_user_input and never become accepted without review.
Generated distill drafts remain candidate and are not auto-accepted even when distill.review_required is set to false.
relia check rejects memory rules whose provenance entries lack resolvable GitHub PR URL receipts.
Review approve, edit, and reject commands write active, candidate human_authored, and retired lifecycle states.
MEMORY.md separates strong active memory from weak candidate, stale, contradicted, and retired memory while preserving resolvable PR receipts.
relia models pull records model ID, version, source URL, license, digest, cache path, update policy, rollback policy, and ready status without network download.
embeddings: local fails closed with exit 8 for stale local model manifests, while signature mode remains zero-install.
No model weights or inference-runtime payloads were added to tracked source, binaries, containers, or release artifacts.
Review rejects edit-only flags unless the review edit subcommand is explicit, and rejects --reason unless review reject is explicit.
Review edit validates proposed scope paths before writing so an invalid path does not mutate the memory rule artifact.
models pull rejects cache paths that target the local model manifest path before writing the manifest.
